entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Linear strength
entries.notes: Hable curve linear-section strength. 0.15 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Linear angle
entries.notes: Hable curve linear-section angle. 0.1 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Toe strength
entries.notes: Hable curve toe (shadow roll-off) strength. 0.2 = default. Higher lifts/softens shadows.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ White point
entries.notes: Luminance mapped to display white by the Hable curve. 11.2 = default. Lower it to blow out sooner, raise to retain more highlight range.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ LUT (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for a 3D LUT look. off = neutral (no LUT). A LUT is a display-side creative grade; keep identical across attempts once chosen.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ LUT ▸ Amount
entries.notes: Blend amount of the LUT (0 = off, 1 = full). 1.0 = default when a LUT is loaded.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ LUT ▸ LUT file
entries.notes: The .cube/.3dl LUT file. none = unset. Value = LUT file or look description.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ LUT ▸ Color space
entries.notes: Options: sRGB | ACEScg | ... — color space the LUT expects its input in. sRGB = default. Pipeline detail — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for the Lens Effects (glare/bloom) group. off = neutral. A bloom/glare look is display-side; add only if the reference clearly glows.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Recalculate after X samples
entries.notes: How often the lens effect is recomputed during progressive rendering. 5 = default. Perf/sampling detail — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Size
entries.notes: Size/spread of the glare. 30.0 = default. Active with Lens Effects on.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Intensity
entries.notes: Overall glare intensity. 1.0 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Bloom
entries.notes: Bloom amount within the lens effect. 0.4 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Threshold
entries.notes: Luminance threshold above which pixels glare. 1.0 = default. Raise to restrict glare to only the brightest highlights.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Rotation
entries.notes: Rotation of the star/diffraction pattern. 0.0 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Saturation
entries.notes: Saturation of the glare color. 1.0 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ Bloom ▸ Intensity
entries.notes: Intensity of the dedicated Bloom sub-effect. 0.3 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ Bloom ▸ Threshold
entries.notes: Luminance threshold for the Bloom sub-effect. 1.0 = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ Bloom ▸ Iterations / spread
entries.notes: Blur iterations controlling bloom spread. 5 = default. Quality/spread detail — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Blur / Sharpen (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for blur/sharpen. off = neutral. Image-detail post, not lighting — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Blur / Sharpen ▸ Blur radius
entries.notes: Gaussian blur radius. 1.0 = default. Image-detail post — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Blur / Sharpen ▸ Sharpen radius
entries.notes: Unsharp-mask radius. 1.0 = default. Image-detail post — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Blur / Sharpen ▸ Sharpen amount
entries.notes: Unsharp-mask amount. 0.0 = default (no sharpening). Image-detail post — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for the global Hue/Saturation/Lightness sliders. off = neutral.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation ▸ Hue
entries.notes: Global hue rotation in DEGREES (grey stays intact); 0 = no change. Range −180..180° doc-confirmed (Chaos HSL color-correction docs, 2026-07-05) — this is ANGULAR, NOT the normalized −1..1 the sibling Saturation uses: the Color-corrections family is NOT uniform, each control has its own scale.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation ▸ Saturation
entries.notes: Positive = more vibrant, negative = desaturated (docs); 0 = no change. Requires the Hue / Saturation toggle ON. Slider bounds −1..1 USER-CONFIRMED in the live Vantage product 2026-07-05 (max = 1). NOTE: Chaos Player docs list this control as −100..+∞ for that product, so the scale is product-specific — trust the Vantage in-product read here. Typical grades sit within ±0.3.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation ▸ Lightness
entries.notes: Global lightness (higher adds white, lower subtracts); 0 = no change. Range −1..1 is INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation and NOT individually confirmed — since Hue turned out to be degrees, do not trust the family as uniform. Provisional; confirm the real Lightness slider bounds in the live Vantage UI. Keep adjustments small until then.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Color mixer (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for the 12-channel per-color hue/saturation/lightness mixer. off = neutral. Per-channel swatches (below) are folded — display-only detail; leave at defaults unless a specific color needs targeting.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Color mixer ▸ Show color affected area
entries.notes: Overlays which pixels the selected channel affects, for tuning. off = default. Diagnostic overlay — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Color balance (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for the three color-balance sliders (per range tab: All/Highlights/Midtones/Shadows). off = neutral.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ Cyan – Red
entries.notes: Shifts the selected tonal range along cyan↔red; 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm the real slider bounds in the live Vantage UI.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ Magenta – Green
entries.notes: Shifts the selected tonal range along magenta↔green; 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm in the live Vantage UI.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ Yellow – Blue
entries.notes: Shifts the selected tonal range along yellow↔blue; 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm in the live Vantage UI.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ range tabs (All / Highlights / Midtones / Shadows)
entries.notes: Options: All | Highlights | Midtones | Shadows — which tonal range the three balance sliders act on. All = default.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ White balance (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for the post white-balance (Temperature + tint + color). off = neutral.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ White balance ▸ Temperature
entries.notes: Lower = bluer, higher = more amber (docs). 6500 K = neutral (no correction; derived, not doc-stated). Requires the White balance toggle ON. Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ White balance ▸ Magenta-Green tint
entries.notes: Positive = greener, negative = more purple (docs); 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm in the live Vantage UI. Keep tint fixes small until then.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ White balance ▸ Color
entries.notes: Color-swatch white balance (an alternative to the Temperature/tint numerics). white = neutral. Emit as a color instruction.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Chromatic aberration (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for the CA lens effect. off = neutral. Lens artifact, not lighting — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Chromatic aberration ▸ Value
entries.notes: Strength of the RGB fringing at frame edges. 0.0 = default (none). Lens artifact — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Overlay (toggle)
entries.notes: Master toggle for a composited overlay (color or image). off = neutral. Compositing, not lighting — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Overlay ▸ Blend mode
entries.notes: Options: Normal | Multiply | Screen | Overlay | ... — how the overlay composites. Normal = default. Compositing — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Overlay ▸ Opacity
entries.notes: Overlay opacity (%). 75 = default. Compositing — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Overlay ▸ Source
entries.notes: Options: Color | Image — whether the overlay is a flat color or a loaded image. Color = default. Compositing — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Color correction tab ▸ Overlay ▸ Color
entries.notes: The overlay color when Source = Color. white = default. Compositing — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Enable fog
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Enables the first aerial-perspective fog layer (the docs' examples call it Simple Fog 1); off = no fog (neutral; startup state not printed). A second identical layer exists as Enable fog 2 with its own range/height/start/opacity/color for two-tone atmospheres (docs).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog visibility range
entries.notes: Distance in KILOMETERS at which the fog absorbs 90% of the light behind it; lower = denser (docs; examples 10/50/100/150). Default 10 km confirmed from the UI capture. Note the unit — km here, meters on the V-Ray aerial control. Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog height
entries.notes: Height of the fog layer in meters (docs; examples 100-2000). Default 500 m confirmed from the UI capture. Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog start distance
entries.notes: Distance from the camera at which the fog starts (docs; examples 0-20000 — unit not printed; sibling heights are meters). 0 = fog starts at the camera (neutral offset, derived). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog max opacity
entries.notes: Doc-stated scale: 1 = fog completely opaque, 0 = invisible. Lower it to keep distant objects readable through the haze (docs; examples 0.01-1). Factory value not printed (1.0 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog color
entries.notes: Color swatch for the fog layer (docs; examples white/blue/grey/orange/yellow). Emit as an instruction, e.g. 'cool blue-grey morning mist'. Default informational.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Enable scattering fog
entries.notes: Options: on | off. True volumetric scattering fog with light-shaft support — heavier than the simple layers (docs); off = neutral. Further doc-listed sub-controls not shipped here: Fog transparency + Fog emission colors, Fog start / Fog end, Fog max opacity, Fog light boost (multiplier pushing visible light shafts; docs examples 1-8), Affect secondary rays, Scatter only infinite direct lights.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog distance
entries.notes: Density control for the scattering fog: larger = more transparent, smaller = denser (docs; examples 5-30, unit not printed). Default 10 confirmed from the UI capture (inventory: distance 10 m).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog height
entries.notes: Height of the scattering fog in meters (docs; examples 2-16 — a ground-hugging scale, unlike the simple layer's hundreds of meters). Default 10 m confirmed from the UI capture.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog light boost
entries.notes: Multiplier pushing the visible light shafts through the scattering fog (docs; examples 1-8). Default 1.0 confirmed from the UI capture.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog max opacity
entries.notes: Max opacity of the scattering fog (1 = fully opaque, 0 = invisible). Default 1.0 confirmed from the UI capture.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Affect secondary rays
entries.notes: Whether the scattering fog also affects reflection/refraction (secondary) rays. off = default (camera rays only), for speed.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Scatter only infinite direct lights
entries.notes: Restricts visible shafts to infinite (sun/dome) lights only. off = default (all lights scatter).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Scatter GI
entries.notes: Options: on | off. The fog also scatters GI — can be quite slow; docs suggest the Fog emission term as a cheap substitute. Factory state not printed (off assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Texture mode
entries.notes: Options: Off | Built-in smoke density | From V-Ray scene (docs). Off = homogeneous fog (neutral no-texture state). Built-in smoke adds procedural clusters — Smoke size (m) / num iterations / exponent — and both texture modes add Ground fog (distance/height/transition) + Raymarch step size / cutoff threshold / max steps (docs). Density-texture detail — display-only.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Enable clouds
entries.notes: Options: on | off. GATING: the Clouds rollout is available only when Environment mode = Physical sky in the Sky rollout (docs) — set env.mode first. off = clear sky (neutral; startup state not printed). Folded sub-toggles (docs): Ground shadows (on = clouds cast shadows — unlike the 3ds Max control of the same name, off removes cloud shadowing outright) and Improved shading (Vantage-only cloud-on-cloud shadowing; results are better in offline rendering).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds settings ▸ Density
entries.notes: Density of the cumulus/stratus clouds — docs describe 100% = sky fully filled and caption their examples 0/0.4/0.8 on a 0-1 scale. Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed). Folded sub-param (docs): Density multiplier — multiplies this; larger darkens the sky at the horizon, 0 removes all clouds; keep 1.0 (neutral) unless the horizon needs darkening.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds settings ▸ Variety
entries.notes: Variety of the cumulus/stratus pattern (docs; examples 0/0.5/1 — range from doc examples). Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds settings ▸ Cirrus amount
entries.notes: Doc-stated scale: maximum 1 fills the sky with cirrus (high-altitude wispy) clouds, 0 = completely gone. Factory value not printed (0 assumed = no cirrus).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds positioning settings ▸ Start height
entries.notes: The clouds' starting height position (docs; examples 500/1000/1500, unit not printed — the V-Ray equivalent Height is meters). Vantage's name for that param. Factory value not printed (1000 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds positioning settings ▸ Thickness
entries.notes: Height of the cloud layer: lower = thin/sheer clouds, higher = full and heavy (docs; examples 200/500/800, unit not printed). Factory value not printed (500 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds settings ▸ Random seed + Clouds positioning settings (Offset X/Y, Phase X/Y) + Contrails settings
entries.notes: Note-entry folding the pattern sub-params (docs). Random seed (Vantage's name for the V-Ray Seed) reseeds the cloud AND contrail pattern — RECIPE-CRITICAL: keep the SAME seed across attempts or the pattern changes while every other value matches. Phase X/Y fine-tweak the pattern and LOOP at 0/100/200; Offset X/Y slide the whole system (units not printed; the V-Ray equivalents are meters). Contrails settings: Enable contrails + number slider (docs: 5-40, spread randomly), strength 0.1-1.0 (lower = fainter/older), distortion, offset X/Y, time (docs animate 0-2). Emit as an instruction, e.g. 'keep Random seed 0 in every attempt'.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Enable wetting (Beta)
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Beta, new in Vantage 3.3: enables a global wetting effect on material surfaces — darkens the diffuse, adds a glossier coat, puddle areas and beaded surface drops (docs). off = dry surfaces (neutral; startup state not printed). Gates the whole rollout (General/Drops and Ripples/Advanced). NOTE: V-Ray 7 has no atmospheric-wetting equivalent — surface wetness there is a material-domain change, outside this pack.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Size
entries.notes: World-space size of the wetting pattern; smaller values produce finer detail (docs). Unit is world-space (meters in a metric scene); factory value not printed in current Chaos docs (1.0 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Wet cover
entries.notes: THE global wetness amount — doc name is Wet cover: surface coverage of the wetting effect when fully rained on; doc-stated scale 0% keeps surfaces dry, 100% makes surfaces uniformly wet (unit % + [0,100] doc-stated). Factory value not printed in current Chaos docs (50 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Puddles
entries.notes: Fraction of the wet area that progresses into puddles; higher values produce more water puddles (docs). Modeled as a 0..1 fraction per the doc's 'fraction' wording; factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Occlusion
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Restricts wetting to areas exposed from above to the rain; disable to wet all surfaces uniformly regardless of occlusion, e.g. under roofs (docs). on = rain-realistic default (only sky-exposed surfaces get wet); off = uniform wetting. Startup state not printed — on is the physically-expected default.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Occlusion slider
entries.notes: World-space radius used to soften the wet/dry boundary at the edge of occluders such as overhangs and ledges (docs' 'Occlusion slider'). Active with Occlusion on. Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Surface drops
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Enables beaded surface droplets. Drops appear ONLY on materials with high reflection glossiness (above 0.75), high metalness (above 0.5), or a glossy coat; diffuse and rough materials receive the wetting effect instead (docs). off = no beaded drops (neutral); startup state not printed.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Surface drops slider
entries.notes: Controls how strongly drops scale with surface wetness; higher values make drops appear sooner and remain more visible as wetness changes (docs' 'Surface drops slider'). Active with Surface drops on. Factory value not printed (1.0 = neutral multiplier assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Tiling
entries.notes: World-space tiling of the drops texture; higher values produce smaller, denser drops (docs). Active with Surface drops on. Factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Amount
entries.notes: Coverage of beaded droplets across the drop-capable area; lower values leave more bare gaps between drops (docs — this is the Amount under Surface drops, distinct from the ripple Amount below). Active with Surface drops on. Modeled as a 0..1 coverage fraction; factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Base bump change
entries.notes: How much the drops perturb the base (under-coat) normal; higher values make drops appear more prominent by distorting diffuse and refraction shading, not just the coat reflection (docs). Active with Surface drops on. Factory value not printed (0.0 = no base perturbation assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Adds animated raindrop ripples to puddle normals (docs). The ripple normals are visible in a still frame even though they animate; off = flat puddles (neutral). Startup state not printed.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples slider
entries.notes: Multiplier for ripple normal strength; higher values produce sharper, more pronounced ripples (docs' 'Puddle ripples slider'). Active with Puddle ripples on. Factory value not printed (1.0 = neutral multiplier assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples ▸ Size
entries.notes: World-space radius of an individual ripple (docs — the Size under Puddle ripples). Active with Puddle ripples on. Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (0.1 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples ▸ Amount
entries.notes: Spawn density of ripples in puddles (docs — the Amount under Puddle ripples, distinct from the Surface drops Amount). Active with Puddle ripples on. Modeled as a 0..1 density; factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle wobble
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Adds slow procedural wobble to puddle normals so still water doesn't look perfectly flat (docs). The wobble distorts puddle normals visibly in a still; off = perfectly flat puddles (neutral). Startup state not printed.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle wobble slider
entries.notes: Multiplier for wobble normal strength (docs' 'Puddle wobble slider'). Active with Puddle wobble on. Factory value not printed (1.0 = neutral multiplier assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle wobble ▸ Size
entries.notes: Spatial scale of the wobble pattern (docs — the Size under Puddle wobble). Active with Puddle wobble on. Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Height effect
entries.notes: How much the height of the material affects the puddle effect; height is read from the bump map, and when no bump map is present the intensity of the diffuse color is used instead (docs). Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Transition
entries.notes: Width of the dry-to-wet and wet-to-puddle transition; larger values produce softer gradients between the three states (docs). Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Diffuse multiplier
entries.notes: How much the diffuse color darkens when fully wet: a value of 1 produces NO darkening, lower values produce the typical 'wet-darkening' look (docs). Default 1.0 = no-darkening neutral (doc-stated). Range [0,1] follows the doc's '1 = none' upper anchor; a typical wet look sits ~0.6-0.8.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Max puddle slope
entries.notes: How steep a surface can be before puddles are suppressed on it; walls and steep slopes still receive the wetting but no puddles (docs). Modeled in degrees (surface slope) over [0,90]; factory value not printed (45 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Noise size
entries.notes: Adds noise to the occlusion spread so the wet/dry boundary is irregular instead of perfectly straight (docs). Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Ray offset
entries.notes: Offsets the occlusion areas in case of non-flat surfaces that create occlusion artifacts (docs) — an artifact-cleanup control, not a look choice. Factory value not printed (0.0 = no offset assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Ripple lifetime
entries.notes: How long a single ripple lives before fading out (docs) — a temporal/animation parameter that does not change a single still frame's look, so lighting:false. Unit seconds (assumed from 'how long ... lives'); factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Wobble speed
entries.notes: Animation speed of the wobble pattern (docs) — a temporal/animation parameter with no effect on a single still, so lighting:false. Factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wind rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Cloud wind direction angle
entries.notes: Specifies the direction from which the wind originates — sets which way the physical-sky clouds are pushed, so it shifts cloud shapes visible in a still sky (docs; examples 10°/100° give the degree unit). AVAILABLE ONLY when Environment mode = Physical sky AND Enable clouds is on (docs). Range [0,360] compass degrees; factory value not printed (0.0 assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wind rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Cloud wind intensity
entries.notes: Specifies the wind strength (how fast the wind blows) for the physical-sky clouds — reshapes/streaks the clouds visible in a still (docs; examples 0 and 100 give the practical range). AVAILABLE ONLY when Environment mode = Physical sky AND Enable clouds is on (docs). Factory value not printed (0.0 = still air assumed).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wind rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Affect vegetation
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Enables VIEWPORT animation of compatible vegetation (e.g. animated Chaos Cosmos trees) to swing with the wind; docs: 'Doesn't affect the final render' — so lighting:false for a still lighting match. Docs recommend using it with the DLSS or Vantage denoiser in interactive mode. off = static vegetation (neutral); startup state not printed.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wind rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Vegetation wind intensity
entries.notes: Wind strength for animated vegetation — speeds or slows the animated assets' motion (docs; examples 100 and 300 give the practical range). Viewport animation only (paired with Affect vegetation), no effect on a still render → lighting:false. Factory value not printed (100 assumed, matching the lower doc example).

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Wind rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Affect water
entries.notes: Options: on | off. Enables VIEWPORT animation of water surface objects; docs: 'Doesn't affect the final render' — so lighting:false for a still lighting match. off = still water (neutral); startup state not printed.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Ambient settings ▸ Ambient light color
entries.notes: Flat ambient light color added to the scene. black = default (no ambient lift). Set a low grey to lift crushed shadows uniformly. Emit as a color instruction.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Ambient settings ▸ Ambient light intensity
entries.notes: Ambient light intensity multiplier. Default 0.0 confirmed from the UI capture (no ambient by default). Raise slightly with a grey ambient color to fill deep shadows.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Ambient settings ▸ Ambient occlusion
entries.notes: Adds screen-space ambient occlusion contact shadows. off = default. Turn on for subtle contact darkening if the reference shows crisp corners.

entries.ui_path: Environment tab ▸ Background rollout ▸ Mode
entries.notes: Options: Same as environment | Solid color | Image. The background override is NOT used for lighting or glossy reflections (docs); Same as environment = no override (neutral).

vantage33.promptFragment:
TARGET: Chaos Vantage 3.3. Allowed parameter ids — choose ONLY from these; numeric values must stay inside the stated ranges:
env.mode — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Environment mode — kind:dropdown default:"Texture" — Options: Texture | Solid Color | Physical Sky. Physical Sky is available only when the imported .vrscene has a VRaySky texture (docs). Startup value follows the imported scene.
env.hdri_slot — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Load environment (Environment mode = Texture) — kind:slot default:"none" — Loads the environment HDRI; RGB color space is deduced automatically (Auto) or set explicitly (docs). Value = HDRI file or mood description, not a number.
env.rgb_color_space — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ RGB color space — kind:dropdown default:"sRGB" — Options: sRGB | ACEScg | ... — color space the loaded environment texture is interpreted in. sRGB = default. Wrong color space skews the environment's color cast.
env.flip_horizontally — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Flip horizontally — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Mirrors the environment texture left-right. off = default. Use to flip the HDRI key-light to the other side.
env.clamp_to_1 — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Clamp to 1 — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Clamps environment values to 1.0, killing HDRI over-brights (and their strong key light). off = default (full HDR range). Leave off for physical lighting.
env.rotation — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Rotation (Environment mode = Texture) — kind:spinner unit:deg range:[0,360] default:0 — Rotation angle in degrees for the environment texture (docs) — use it to swing the HDRI key-light direction.
env.intensity — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Intensity — kind:spinner unit:x range:[0,20] default:1 — Intensity of the environment lighting in every Environment mode (docs). 1.0 = neutral. Practical range; spinner bounds not stated in docs.
env.sky_model — Environment tab ▸ Sky rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Sky model (Environment mode = Physical Sky) — kind:dropdown default:"PRG Clear Sky" — Options: Preetham et al. | CIE Clear | CIE Overcast | Hosek et al. | PRG Clear Sky (old) | PRG Clear Sky. Updated PRG adds observer altitude, twilight to -12 deg and turbidity 1.81-4.89 (docs). Imported scenes keep their VRaySky model; default shown is the current model.
sun.enabled — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Enabled — kind:checkbox default:"on" — Master on/off for Vantage's own sun. Imported V-Ray suns list in the Lights tab as Sun Light; Vantage's own sun is configured here (docs). on = default; state follows the scene.
sun.intensity — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Intensity — kind:spinner unit:x range:[0,2] default:0.033 — Sun brightness multiplier. Default 0.033 confirmed from the UI capture (Vantage's default sun is a small fraction, tuned to its default exposure). Docs describe it as a way to reduce brightness; prefer exposure moves first. Practical range; UI accepts higher.
sun.size — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Sun size — kind:spinner unit:x range:[0.2,40] default:1 — Visible sun-disc size and shadow softness: lower = sharp shadows, higher = soft (docs). 1.0 = real sun. Practical range. On an imported Sun Light (Lights tab) the label is Sun size mult. (docs).
sun.color_mode — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Color mode — kind:dropdown default:"Filter" — Options: Filter | Direct | Override (docs). The Vantage sun has NO Kelvin control — warmth comes from Altitude + sky model, or Direct with a warm Color; numeric kelvin lives in post.wb_kelvin. Filter + white color = neutral/physical. Same control + options on an imported Sun Light (docs).
sun.position_mode — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Sun position mode — kind:dropdown default:"Altitude/Azimuth" — Options: Manual | Altitude/Azimuth | Geolocation | Animated Geolocation (docs). Set Altitude/Azimuth so numeric recipe moves apply; scene default follows the import. On an imported Sun Light (Lights tab) the label is Sun position (docs).
sun.elevation — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Altitude (Sun position mode = Altitude/Azimuth) — kind:spinner unit:deg range:[-18,90] default:45 — Vantage names this control Altitude (this pack keys it sun.elevation): 0 = horizon, 90 = zenith; negative values give twilight (PRG sky renders the sun to -12 deg, docs). Default 45.0 confirmed from the UI capture. Same control on an imported Sun Light (docs).
sun.azimuth — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Azimuth (Sun position mode = Altitude/Azimuth) — kind:spinner unit:deg range:[0,360] default:135 — Compass azimuth from scene North, eastward — 90 = East (docs convention). Default 135.0 confirmed from the UI capture. Same control on an imported Sun Light (docs).
sun.invisible — Environment tab ▸ Sun and Moon rollout ▸ Sun tab ▸ Invisible — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Hides the sun disc from camera rays; it still lights the scene. off = default (disc visible). Turn on to keep a bright sun out of frame.
cam.exposure_mode — Camera tab ▸ Current camera options ▸ Exposure (advanced) ▸ Exposure — kind:dropdown default:"Value" — Options: None | Physical | Value (docs). Physical uses ISO/F-Number/Shutter speed; Value uses Exposure Value and greys out ISO. Startup default not stated in current Chaos docs (Value assumed).
cam.exposure_value — Camera tab ▸ Current camera options ▸ Exposure (advanced) ▸ Exposure Value (Exposure = Value) — kind:spinner unit:EV range:[-6,26] default:14 — Photographic EV: HIGHER = darker image. Sunny exterior lands around 14-15, interiors around 8-10; docs' twilight example uses EV 10. Factory default not stated in current Chaos docs (14 assumed).
cam.fnumber — Camera tab ▸ Current camera options ▸ Exposure (advanced) ▸ F-Number (Exposure = Physical) — kind:spinner unit:f/ range:[0.7,64] default:8 — Lens aperture; lower = brighter + more DOF. Active only when Exposure = Physical. Factory default not stated in current Chaos docs (8.0 assumed).
cam.wb — Camera tab ▸ White balance (color swatch) — kind:placement default:"no correction (white)" — Color swatch — no Kelvin field on the camera; objects of the picked color render white (docs). Works only when Exposure = Physical or Value (docs). For numeric kelvin use post.wb_kelvin. Emit as an instruction, e.g. 'pick a pale warm tone to cool the image'.
cam.auto_exposure — Viewport bar ▸ Exposure ▸ Toggle auto-exposure — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. When enabled it IGNORES the set camera exposure (docs) — it must be OFF for a recipe and between attempts, or EV moves do nothing. Startup state not stated in current Chaos docs (off recommended).
post.exposure_corrections — Color correction tab ▸ Exposure corrections (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for Exposure bias / Highlight burn / Contrast below; viewport-wide post is also toggled via Viewport bar ▸ Toggle Color Corrections (docs). Neutral = off.
post.exposure_bias — Color correction tab ▸ Exposure corrections ▸ Exposure bias — kind:spinner unit:stops range:[-5,5] default:0 — 0 = no change; the same control is exposed on the Viewport bar (docs). Practical range; slider bounds not stated in docs.
post.highlight_burn — Color correction tab ▸ Exposure corrections ▸ Highlight burn — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:1 — Applies exposure corrections to highlights; hidden while Filmic tonemap is on (docs). Range and neutral value follow the V-Ray burn convention (1.0 = no compression) — not stated in Vantage docs.
post.contrast — Color correction tab ▸ Exposure corrections ▸ Contrast — kind:spinner range:[-1,1] default:0 — Positive pushes colors away from mid grey, negative toward it (docs); 0 = no change. Practical range; slider bounds not stated in docs.
post.filmic_tonemap — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for the filmic tone curve; enabling it hides Highlight burn (docs). off = neutral (no filmic curve).
post.tonemap_type — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Type — kind:dropdown default:"Hable" — Options: Hable | AMPAS (docs — Vantage exposes fewer curve types than the V-Ray VFB). Requires the Filmic tonemap toggle ON; enabling it hides Highlight burn (docs). Default selection not stated in current Chaos docs (Hable assumed).
post.tonemap_gamma — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Gamma — kind:spinner range:[0.1,4] default:1 — Output gamma of the filmic curve. 1.0 = default. Active with Filmic tonemap on.
post.tonemap_shoulder_strength — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Shoulder strength — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.15 — Hable curve shoulder (highlight roll-off) strength. 0.15 = default. Higher softens highlights.
post.tonemap_linear_strength — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Linear strength — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.15 — Hable curve linear-section strength. 0.15 = default.
post.tonemap_linear_angle — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Linear angle — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.1 — Hable curve linear-section angle. 0.1 = default.
post.tonemap_toe_strength — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ Toe strength — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.2 — Hable curve toe (shadow roll-off) strength. 0.2 = default. Higher lifts/softens shadows.
post.tonemap_white_point — Color correction tab ▸ Filmic tonemap ▸ White point — kind:spinner range:[0.1,100] default:11.2 — Luminance mapped to display white by the Hable curve. 11.2 = default. Lower it to blow out sooner, raise to retain more highlight range.
post.lut_enabled — Color correction tab ▸ LUT (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for a 3D LUT look. off = neutral (no LUT). A LUT is a display-side creative grade; keep identical across attempts once chosen.
post.lut_amount — Color correction tab ▸ LUT ▸ Amount — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:1 — Blend amount of the LUT (0 = off, 1 = full). 1.0 = default when a LUT is loaded.
post.lut_file — Color correction tab ▸ LUT ▸ LUT file — kind:slot default:"none" — The .cube/.3dl LUT file. none = unset. Value = LUT file or look description.
post.lens_effects_enabled — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for the Lens Effects (glare/bloom) group. off = neutral. A bloom/glare look is display-side; add only if the reference clearly glows.
post.lens_effects_size — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Size — kind:spinner range:[0,100] default:30 — Size/spread of the glare. 30.0 = default. Active with Lens Effects on.
post.lens_effects_intensity — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Intensity — kind:spinner range:[0,10] default:1 — Overall glare intensity. 1.0 = default.
post.lens_effects_bloom — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Bloom — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.4 — Bloom amount within the lens effect. 0.4 = default.
post.lens_effects_threshold — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Threshold — kind:spinner range:[0,100] default:1 — Luminance threshold above which pixels glare. 1.0 = default. Raise to restrict glare to only the brightest highlights.
post.lens_effects_rotation — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Rotation — kind:spinner unit:deg range:[0,360] default:0 — Rotation of the star/diffraction pattern. 0.0 = default.
post.lens_effects_saturation — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ General ▸ Saturation — kind:spinner range:[0,4] default:1 — Saturation of the glare color. 1.0 = default.
post.bloom_intensity — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ Bloom ▸ Intensity — kind:spinner range:[0,10] default:0.3 — Intensity of the dedicated Bloom sub-effect. 0.3 = default.
post.bloom_threshold — Color correction tab ▸ Lens Effects ▸ Bloom ▸ Threshold — kind:spinner range:[0,100] default:1 — Luminance threshold for the Bloom sub-effect. 1.0 = default.
post.huesat_enabled — Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for the global Hue/Saturation/Lightness sliders. off = neutral.
post.hue — Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation ▸ Hue — kind:spinner unit:° range:[-180,180] default:0 — Global hue rotation in DEGREES (grey stays intact); 0 = no change. Range −180..180° doc-confirmed (Chaos HSL color-correction docs, 2026-07-05) — this is ANGULAR, NOT the normalized −1..1 the sibling Saturation uses: the Color-corrections family is NOT uniform, each control has its own scale.
post.saturation — Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation ▸ Saturation — kind:spinner range:[-1,1] default:0 — Positive = more vibrant, negative = desaturated (docs); 0 = no change. Requires the Hue / Saturation toggle ON. Slider bounds −1..1 USER-CONFIRMED in the live Vantage product 2026-07-05 (max = 1). NOTE: Chaos Player docs list this control as −100..+∞ for that product, so the scale is product-specific — trust the Vantage in-product read here. Typical grades sit within ±0.3.
post.lightness — Color correction tab ▸ Hue / Saturation ▸ Lightness — kind:spinner range:[-1,1] default:0 — Global lightness (higher adds white, lower subtracts); 0 = no change. Range −1..1 is INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation and NOT individually confirmed — since Hue turned out to be degrees, do not trust the family as uniform. Provisional; confirm the real Lightness slider bounds in the live Vantage UI. Keep adjustments small until then.
post.color_mixer_enabled — Color correction tab ▸ Color mixer (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for the 12-channel per-color hue/saturation/lightness mixer. off = neutral. Per-channel swatches (below) are folded — display-only detail; leave at defaults unless a specific color needs targeting.
post.color_balance_enabled — Color correction tab ▸ Color balance (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for the three color-balance sliders (per range tab: All/Highlights/Midtones/Shadows). off = neutral.
post.balance_cyan_red — Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ Cyan – Red — kind:spinner range:[-1,1] default:0 — Shifts the selected tonal range along cyan↔red; 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm the real slider bounds in the live Vantage UI.
post.balance_magenta_green — Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ Magenta – Green — kind:spinner range:[-1,1] default:0 — Shifts the selected tonal range along magenta↔green; 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm in the live Vantage UI.
post.balance_yellow_blue — Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ Yellow – Blue — kind:spinner range:[-1,1] default:0 — Shifts the selected tonal range along yellow↔blue; 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm in the live Vantage UI.
post.balance_range — Color correction tab ▸ Color balance ▸ range tabs (All / Highlights / Midtones / Shadows) — kind:dropdown default:"All" — Options: All | Highlights | Midtones | Shadows — which tonal range the three balance sliders act on. All = default.
post.wb_enabled — Color correction tab ▸ White balance (toggle) — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Master toggle for the post white-balance (Temperature + tint + color). off = neutral.
post.wb_kelvin — Color correction tab ▸ White balance ▸ Temperature — kind:spinner unit:K range:[1000,20000] default:6500 — Lower = bluer, higher = more amber (docs). 6500 K = neutral (no correction; derived, not doc-stated). Requires the White balance toggle ON. Practical range.
post.wb_tint — Color correction tab ▸ White balance ▸ Magenta-Green tint — kind:spinner range:[-1,1] default:0 — Positive = greener, negative = more purple (docs); 0 = neutral. Range −1..1 INFERRED from the confirmed Saturation, NOT individually confirmed (the family is not uniform — Hue is degrees). Provisional; confirm in the live Vantage UI. Keep tint fixes small until then.
post.wb_color — Color correction tab ▸ White balance ▸ Color — kind:color default:"white" — Color-swatch white balance (an alternative to the Temperature/tint numerics). white = neutral. Emit as a color instruction.
fog.enabled — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Enable fog — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. Enables the first aerial-perspective fog layer (the docs' examples call it Simple Fog 1); off = no fog (neutral; startup state not printed). A second identical layer exists as Enable fog 2 with its own range/height/start/opacity/color for two-tone atmospheres (docs).
fog.visibility_range — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog visibility range — kind:spinner unit:km range:[0.1,300] default:10 — Distance in KILOMETERS at which the fog absorbs 90% of the light behind it; lower = denser (docs; examples 10/50/100/150). Default 10 km confirmed from the UI capture. Note the unit — km here, meters on the V-Ray aerial control. Practical range.
fog.height — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog height — kind:spinner unit:m range:[1,10000] default:500 — Height of the fog layer in meters (docs; examples 100-2000). Default 500 m confirmed from the UI capture. Practical range.
fog.start_distance — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog start distance — kind:spinner range:[0,50000] default:0 — Distance from the camera at which the fog starts (docs; examples 0-20000 — unit not printed; sibling heights are meters). 0 = fog starts at the camera (neutral offset, derived). Practical range.
fog.max_opacity — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog max opacity — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:1 — Doc-stated scale: 1 = fog completely opaque, 0 = invisible. Lower it to keep distant objects readable through the haze (docs; examples 0.01-1). Factory value not printed (1.0 assumed).
fog.color — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Fog color — kind:color default:"white" — Color swatch for the fog layer (docs; examples white/blue/grey/orange/yellow). Emit as an instruction, e.g. 'cool blue-grey morning mist'. Default informational.
fog.scatter_enabled — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Enable scattering fog — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. True volumetric scattering fog with light-shaft support — heavier than the simple layers (docs); off = neutral. Further doc-listed sub-controls not shipped here: Fog transparency + Fog emission colors, Fog start / Fog end, Fog max opacity, Fog light boost (multiplier pushing visible light shafts; docs examples 1-8), Affect secondary rays, Scatter only infinite direct lights.
fog.scatter_distance — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog distance — kind:spinner range:[0.1,1000] default:10 — Density control for the scattering fog: larger = more transparent, smaller = denser (docs; examples 5-30, unit not printed). Default 10 confirmed from the UI capture (inventory: distance 10 m).
fog.scatter_height — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog height — kind:spinner unit:m range:[0.1,500] default:10 — Height of the scattering fog in meters (docs; examples 2-16 — a ground-hugging scale, unlike the simple layer's hundreds of meters). Default 10 m confirmed from the UI capture.
fog.scatter_light_boost — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog light boost — kind:spinner unit:x range:[0,8] default:1 — Multiplier pushing the visible light shafts through the scattering fog (docs; examples 1-8). Default 1.0 confirmed from the UI capture.
fog.scatter_max_opacity — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Fog max opacity — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:1 — Max opacity of the scattering fog (1 = fully opaque, 0 = invisible). Default 1.0 confirmed from the UI capture.
fog.scatter_affect_secondary — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Affect secondary rays — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Whether the scattering fog also affects reflection/refraction (secondary) rays. off = default (camera rays only), for speed.
fog.scatter_infinite_only — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Scatter only infinite direct lights — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Restricts visible shafts to infinite (sun/dome) lights only. off = default (all lights scatter).
fog.scatter_gi — Environment tab ▸ Fog rollout ▸ Scattering Fog ▸ Scatter GI — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. The fog also scatters GI — can be quite slow; docs suggest the Fog emission term as a cheap substitute. Factory state not printed (off assumed).
clouds.enabled — Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Enable clouds — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. GATING: the Clouds rollout is available only when Environment mode = Physical sky in the Sky rollout (docs) — set env.mode first. off = clear sky (neutral; startup state not printed). Folded sub-toggles (docs): Ground shadows (on = clouds cast shadows — unlike the 3ds Max control of the same name, off removes cloud shadowing outright) and Improved shading (Vantage-only cloud-on-cloud shadowing; results are better in offline rendering).
clouds.density — Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds settings ▸ Density — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.5 — Density of the cumulus/stratus clouds — docs describe 100% = sky fully filled and caption their examples 0/0.4/0.8 on a 0-1 scale. Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed). Folded sub-param (docs): Density multiplier — multiplies this; larger darkens the sky at the horizon, 0 removes all clouds; keep 1.0 (neutral) unless the horizon needs darkening.
clouds.variety — Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds settings ▸ Variety — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.5 — Variety of the cumulus/stratus pattern (docs; examples 0/0.5/1 — range from doc examples). Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).
clouds.cirrus_amount — Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds settings ▸ Cirrus amount — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0 — Doc-stated scale: maximum 1 fills the sky with cirrus (high-altitude wispy) clouds, 0 = completely gone. Factory value not printed (0 assumed = no cirrus).
clouds.start_height — Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds positioning settings ▸ Start height — kind:spinner range:[100,10000] default:1000 — The clouds' starting height position (docs; examples 500/1000/1500, unit not printed — the V-Ray equivalent Height is meters). Vantage's name for that param. Factory value not printed (1000 assumed).
clouds.thickness — Environment tab ▸ Clouds rollout ▸ Clouds positioning settings ▸ Thickness — kind:spinner range:[10,5000] default:500 — Height of the cloud layer: lower = thin/sheer clouds, higher = full and heavy (docs; examples 200/500/800, unit not printed). Factory value not printed (500 assumed).
wet.enabled — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Enable wetting (Beta) — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. Beta, new in Vantage 3.3: enables a global wetting effect on material surfaces — darkens the diffuse, adds a glossier coat, puddle areas and beaded surface drops (docs). off = dry surfaces (neutral; startup state not printed). Gates the whole rollout (General/Drops and Ripples/Advanced). NOTE: V-Ray 7 has no atmospheric-wetting equivalent — surface wetness there is a material-domain change, outside this pack.
wet.size — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Size — kind:spinner unit:m range:[0.01,100] default:1 — World-space size of the wetting pattern; smaller values produce finer detail (docs). Unit is world-space (meters in a metric scene); factory value not printed in current Chaos docs (1.0 assumed). Practical range.
wet.amount — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Wet cover — kind:spinner unit:% range:[0,100] default:50 — THE global wetness amount — doc name is Wet cover: surface coverage of the wetting effect when fully rained on; doc-stated scale 0% keeps surfaces dry, 100% makes surfaces uniformly wet (unit % + [0,100] doc-stated). Factory value not printed in current Chaos docs (50 assumed).
wet.puddles — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Puddles — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.5 — Fraction of the wet area that progresses into puddles; higher values produce more water puddles (docs). Modeled as a 0..1 fraction per the doc's 'fraction' wording; factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).
wet.occlusion — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Occlusion — kind:dropdown default:"on" — Options: on | off. Restricts wetting to areas exposed from above to the rain; disable to wet all surfaces uniformly regardless of occlusion, e.g. under roofs (docs). on = rain-realistic default (only sky-exposed surfaces get wet); off = uniform wetting. Startup state not printed — on is the physically-expected default.
wet.occlusion_radius — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ General tab ▸ Occlusion slider — kind:spinner unit:m range:[0,100] default:1 — World-space radius used to soften the wet/dry boundary at the edge of occluders such as overhangs and ledges (docs' 'Occlusion slider'). Active with Occlusion on. Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.
wet.surface_drops — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Surface drops — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. Enables beaded surface droplets. Drops appear ONLY on materials with high reflection glossiness (above 0.75), high metalness (above 0.5), or a glossy coat; diffuse and rough materials receive the wetting effect instead (docs). off = no beaded drops (neutral); startup state not printed.
wet.surface_drops_scale — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Surface drops slider — kind:spinner range:[0,2] default:1 — Controls how strongly drops scale with surface wetness; higher values make drops appear sooner and remain more visible as wetness changes (docs' 'Surface drops slider'). Active with Surface drops on. Factory value not printed (1.0 = neutral multiplier assumed). Practical range.
wet.drops_tiling — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Tiling — kind:spinner range:[0.01,100] default:1 — World-space tiling of the drops texture; higher values produce smaller, denser drops (docs). Active with Surface drops on. Factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.
wet.drops_amount — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Amount — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.5 — Coverage of beaded droplets across the drop-capable area; lower values leave more bare gaps between drops (docs — this is the Amount under Surface drops, distinct from the ripple Amount below). Active with Surface drops on. Modeled as a 0..1 coverage fraction; factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).
wet.drops_base_bump — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Base bump change — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0 — How much the drops perturb the base (under-coat) normal; higher values make drops appear more prominent by distorting diffuse and refraction shading, not just the coat reflection (docs). Active with Surface drops on. Factory value not printed (0.0 = no base perturbation assumed). Practical range.
wet.puddle_ripples — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. Adds animated raindrop ripples to puddle normals (docs). The ripple normals are visible in a still frame even though they animate; off = flat puddles (neutral). Startup state not printed.
wet.puddle_ripples_strength — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples slider — kind:spinner range:[0,2] default:1 — Multiplier for ripple normal strength; higher values produce sharper, more pronounced ripples (docs' 'Puddle ripples slider'). Active with Puddle ripples on. Factory value not printed (1.0 = neutral multiplier assumed). Practical range.
wet.ripple_size — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples ▸ Size — kind:spinner unit:m range:[0.001,10] default:0.1 — World-space radius of an individual ripple (docs — the Size under Puddle ripples). Active with Puddle ripples on. Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (0.1 assumed). Practical range.
wet.ripple_amount — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle ripples ▸ Amount — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.5 — Spawn density of ripples in puddles (docs — the Amount under Puddle ripples, distinct from the Surface drops Amount). Active with Puddle ripples on. Modeled as a 0..1 density; factory value not printed (0.5 assumed).
wet.puddle_wobble — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle wobble — kind:dropdown default:"off" — Options: on | off. Adds slow procedural wobble to puddle normals so still water doesn't look perfectly flat (docs). The wobble distorts puddle normals visibly in a still; off = perfectly flat puddles (neutral). Startup state not printed.
wet.puddle_wobble_strength — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle wobble slider — kind:spinner range:[0,2] default:1 — Multiplier for wobble normal strength (docs' 'Puddle wobble slider'). Active with Puddle wobble on. Factory value not printed (1.0 = neutral multiplier assumed). Practical range.
wet.wobble_size — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Drops and Ripples tab ▸ Puddle wobble ▸ Size — kind:spinner unit:m range:[0.001,100] default:1 — Spatial scale of the wobble pattern (docs — the Size under Puddle wobble). Active with Puddle wobble on. Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.
wet.height_effect — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Height effect — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.5 — How much the height of the material affects the puddle effect; height is read from the bump map, and when no bump map is present the intensity of the diffuse color is used instead (docs). Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed). Practical range.
wet.transition — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Transition — kind:spinner range:[0,1] default:0.5 — Width of the dry-to-wet and wet-to-puddle transition; larger values produce softer gradients between the three states (docs). Factory value not printed (0.5 assumed). Practical range.
wet.diffuse_mult — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Diffuse multiplier — kind:spinner unit:x range:[0,1] default:1 — How much the diffuse color darkens when fully wet: a value of 1 produces NO darkening, lower values produce the typical 'wet-darkening' look (docs). Default 1.0 = no-darkening neutral (doc-stated). Range [0,1] follows the doc's '1 = none' upper anchor; a typical wet look sits ~0.6-0.8.
wet.max_puddle_slope — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Max puddle slope — kind:spinner unit:° range:[0,90] default:45 — How steep a surface can be before puddles are suppressed on it; walls and steep slopes still receive the wetting but no puddles (docs). Modeled in degrees (surface slope) over [0,90]; factory value not printed (45 assumed). Practical range.
wet.noise_size — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Noise size — kind:spinner unit:m range:[0,100] default:1 — Adds noise to the occlusion spread so the wet/dry boundary is irregular instead of perfectly straight (docs). Unit world-space (meters); factory value not printed (1.0 assumed). Practical range.
wet.ray_offset — Environment tab ▸ Wetting rollout ▸ Advanced tab ▸ Ray offset — kind:spinner range:[0,10] default:0 — Offsets the occlusion areas in case of non-flat surfaces that create occlusion artifacts (docs) — an artifact-cleanup control, not a look choice. Factory value not printed (0.0 = no offset assumed). Practical range.
wind.cloud_direction — Environment tab ▸ Wind rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Cloud wind direction angle — kind:spinner unit:° range:[0,360] default:0 — Specifies the direction from which the wind originates — sets which way the physical-sky clouds are pushed, so it shifts cloud shapes visible in a still sky (docs; examples 10°/100° give the degree unit). AVAILABLE ONLY when Environment mode = Physical sky AND Enable clouds is on (docs). Range [0,360] compass degrees; factory value not printed (0.0 assumed).
wind.cloud_intensity — Environment tab ▸ Wind rollout ▸ Settings ▸ Cloud wind intensity — kind:spinner range:[0,100] default:0 — Specifies the wind strength (how fast the wind blows) for the physical-sky clouds — reshapes/streaks the clouds visible in a still (docs; examples 0 and 100 give the practical range). AVAILABLE ONLY when Environment mode = Physical sky AND Enable clouds is on (docs). Factory value not printed (0.0 = still air assumed).
amb.color — Environment tab ▸ Ambient settings ▸ Ambient light color — kind:color default:"black" — Flat ambient light color added to the scene. black = default (no ambient lift). Set a low grey to lift crushed shadows uniformly. Emit as a color instruction.
amb.intensity — Environment tab ▸ Ambient settings ▸ Ambient light intensity — kind:spinner unit:x range:[0,100] default:0 — Ambient light intensity multiplier. Default 0.0 confirmed from the UI capture (no ambient by default). Raise slightly with a grey ambient color to fill deep shadows.
amb.occlusion — Environment tab ▸ Ambient settings ▸ Ambient occlusion — kind:checkbox default:"off" — Adds screen-space ambient occlusion contact shadows. off = default. Turn on for subtle contact darkening if the reference shows crisp corners.
env.background_mode — Environment tab ▸ Background rollout ▸ Mode — kind:dropdown default:"Same as environment" — Options: Same as environment | Solid color | Image. The background override is NOT used for lighting or glossy reflections (docs); Same as environment = no override (neutral).
